Steve travels 3 miles, which is \(3 \times 5280 = 15840\) feet. At 440 feet per minute, his time is \(15840 \div 440 = 36\) minutes.

Tim travels 2 miles, which is \(2 \times 5280 = 10560\) feet. At 264 feet per minute, his time is \(10560 \div 264 = 40\) minutes.

Steve finishes first and waits for Tim. The waiting time is the difference: \(40 - 36 = 4\) minutes.

Answer: 4
